environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed via AWS Cloud Map into a service mesh namespace with Envoy sidecar proxy (App Mesh). The Envoy sidecar is configured with an egress filter in ALLOW_LIST mode where only explicitly registered virtual services and the ECS metadata endpoint (169.254.170.2/32 on port 80) are permitted as outbound destinations. Additionally, the task's security group has outbound rules restricted to port 443 for the VPC endpoint CIDR and port 80 for 169.254.170.2/32 only. The Envoy proxy intercepts all outbound traffic on port 15001 via iptables REDIRECT rules injected by the init container (proxyIngressPort/proxyEgressPort configuration). The proxy applies header validation that strips any header value containing bytes 0x0A or 0x0D before forwarding upstream, as part of the Envoy HTTP connection manager's header sanitization (envoy.extensions.http.header_validators.envoy_default with configured reject_cr_in_header_value and reject_lf_in_header_value). The ALB target group health check path is /internal/health.

config.proxy_interception: iptables REDIRECT to port 15001 for all egress
